notes: Kinematic swimming reference for the paddle crab, keyframed by eye from blue crab footage (FASTEC clips 000106 and 000094). See kinematic_ref.py for the format and joint conventions.

One paddle stroke is shared by every mode; phase 0 is the paddle upright at the start of its power stroke. Power: broadside (feather 0) sweep up and over the back toward the trailing side. Recovery: feathered edge-on, back to upright and past it toward the leading side.
A paddle that looks broad to a camera faces it, so it is edge-on to a sweep across the image; one that looks thin is broadside to it.

sideways (000106, front view slightly below, the crab swims toward its own left; the robot is mirrored for it, never the footage): the leading paddle strokes, the trailing one is held ~45 deg outward and moves less; the leading hanging leg folds up during the sweep.

paddles_first (000094, side view, anterior on screen left, the crab swims toward its own back, to screen right): both paddles point back and use the same stroke, alternating (the far paddle ~0.6 of a stroke behind the near one); claws held forward, centre legs hanging down and back.

History: v1 inverted broad/thin; v2 fixed it; v3 matched sweep timing; v4/v5 compared both clips through mirrored footage and misread 000094's orientation; v6 has no mirrored footage, a shared stroke and the paddles_first mode.
